subject: Decision (supersedes 170cb2): the YouTube player runs on a separate-origin static Space arrowassassin/naadi-player (created, public, empty). seg20 builds and deploys it
body:
Owner approved. Host: https://arrowassassin-naadi-player.static.hf.space (static SDK, a different site from arrowassassin-naadi.hf.space, so no access to Naadi storage or cookies).
- Source lives under deploy/player-space/ (README.md frontmatter sdk: static, plus index.html and player.js, with no inline script). The page's own CSP comes from a meta tag: script-src 'self' https://www.youtube.com https://s.ytimg.com; frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; connect-src 'none'; frame-ancestors is not settable by meta, so the page checks document.referrer and ancestorOrigins against an allowlist and refuses otherwise.
- Naadi embeds it in an iframe with allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-presentation (no allow-top-navigation, no allow-forms), with allow="autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture; encrypted-media". Same-origin here means the player's own origin, which holds nothing. Don't put a sandbox on the nested youtube-nocookie frame.
- Typed postMessage bridge as before. Both sides check event.origin exactly (the Naadi origin comes from a ?parent= param validated against the allowlist; Naadi accepts only the player origin) as well as the shape. The player origin is a config value (app_config or a Space variable), not hard-coded in components.
- Parent CSP: script-src 'self' stays. frame-src adds only the player origin.
- Deploy: a scripts/deploy_player_space.sh using huggingface_hub upload_folder, plus a CI step next to the main deploy. seg20 may deploy it now with HF_TOKEN from env to test real playback.
- e2e: keep the stub for the matrix, and add one real-YouTube spec against the deployed player (tag @live, run on demand), plus a unit test for the origin checks.
Also fix every other review20 item: the 2 HIGH .apkg DoS (refuse views and triggers or open the collection read-only with a query timeout or progress handler; a linear-time cloze parser with a field-size cap), the 2 MEDIUM, the 2 LOW and the nit. The 0024 downgrade bug belongs to seg19 (separate note).
